item.description:
Add Sparkle updates, DMG packaging and release automation

- Embed Sparkle 2.9.6 and add Check for Updates to both menus. Sparkle is
optional: without the framework, Updater.swift compiles to a stub.
- build.sh re-signs the Sparkle framework innermost-first with the app's own
identity. dyld refuses to load a framework whose Team ID differs from the
process, which is why the framework cannot keep its upstream signature.
- scripts/fetch-sparkle.sh, make-dmg.sh, make-appcast.sh.
- GitHub Actions: build on push, and on a v* tag build, package, EdDSA-sign,
publish a release and commit the appcast.
- Correct the privacy claims: the update check is one network request, and
README and the site now say so instead of "no network at all".
